word: take it with a grain of salt
pronunciationKo: 테이크 잇 윗 어 그레인 오브 솔트
meaningKo: 씩씩하게 받아들이다, 일정 부분 거짓으로 간주하다
exampleEn: You should take his advice with a grain of salt.
exampleKo: 그의 조언은 일정 부분 거짓으로 여겨야 해.
gameExamples: When she told me about her wild weekend, I decided to take it with a grain of salt.
His stories are often exaggerated, so I always take it with a grain of salt.
You can listen to the rumors, but remember to take it with a grain of salt.
